exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni namunadagidek tuzating. 1 He asked me what was the time. → the time was. I told that it was three o'clock. 2 She asked me that I had a pet. I said her that I had a dog. 3 Mike said Joanne if she would like to go to the cinema. 'Yes, I'd love to,' she told. 4 I asked him why had he done that. He said that he haven't done anything.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP XATOLARI.

  1a so'roq tartibi XATO →
     'what THE TIME WAS' (gap
     tartibi)
  1b 'told' + kishi kerak → 'I told
     HIM' / 'I SAID that'
  2a savol 'that' bilan EMAS →
     'asked me IF I had'
  2b 'said her' XATO → 'TOLD her'
  3a 'said Joanne if' XATO → 'ASKED
     Joanne if'
  3b 'she told' (kishisiz) XATO →
     'she SAID'
  4a so'roq tartibi XATO → 'why HE
     HAD done that'
  4b zamon XATO → 'he HADN'T done'
     (past perfect)


⚠ ASOSIY QOIDALAR:

  say (to sb) / tell SB
  ask sb IF / WH- + gap tartibi
  zamon bir qadam orqaga

items.textEn: He asked me what was the time. → He asked me what ___ .
items.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA. Ko'chirma savolda GAP tartibi: 'what the time was'.

items.textEn: I told that it was three o'clock. → I ___ that it was three o'clock.
She asked me that I had a pet. → She asked me ___ I had a pet.
I said her that I had a dog. → I ___ her that I had a dog.
Mike said Joanne if she would like to go to the cinema. → Mike ___ Joanne if she would like to go to the cinema.
"Yes, I'd love to," she told. → "Yes, I'd love to," she ___ .
I asked him why had he done that. → I asked him why ___ that.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ko'chirma savolda GAP tartibi: 'why he had done'.

items.textEn: He said that he haven't done anything. → He said that he ___ anything.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'haven't done' → 'hadn't done' (past perfect); 'he haven't' - shakl ham xato.

(can't) 'I'm afraid I ___,' he said. 2 'Do you like animals?' she asked me. (if) She asked me ___ animals. 3 We asked how much the dog food cost. (does) 'How much ___?' we asked. 4 'I've never seen a python,' she said to us. (told) She ___ never seen a python. 5 'When will we get there?' they asked. exercises.instructionUz: Har bir gapni qalin harfli so'z bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek. 1 He told me he couldn't help me. (can't) 'I'm afraid I ___,' he said. 2 'Do you like animals?' she asked me. (if) She asked me ___ animals. 3 We asked how much the dog food cost. (does) 'How much ___?' we asked. 4 'I've never seen a python,' she said to us. (told) She ___ never seen a python. 5 'When will we get there?' they asked. (would) They asked ___ get there. 6 'I forgot to do my homework,' he said. (forgotten) He said ___ his homework.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI ↔ KO'ChIRMA - IKKI
  YO'NALISh.

  1 ko'chirma → to'g'ri: couldn't →
    CAN'T help you
  2 to'g'ri → ko'chirma: 'Do you
    like' → IF I LIKED
  3 ko'chirma → to'g'ri: cost →
    DOES the dog food cost
  4 'said to us' → TOLD US (that)
    she HAD never seen
  5 'will we get' → WHEN THEY WOULD
    get there
  6 'forgot' → he HAD FORGOTTEN to
    do


⚠ 'A PYTHON':

  = piton (katta ilon) - coursebook
  hikoyasi 'The Python Hunt'.

items.textEn: He told me he couldn't help me. → "I'm afraid I ___," he said. (can't)
items.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA. Ko'chirma → to'g'ri: couldn't → can't; me → you.

items.textEn: "Do you like animals?" she asked me. → She asked me ___ animals. (if)
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'asked me if I liked' - like → liked.

items.textEn: We asked how much the dog food cost. → "How much ___?" we asked. (does)
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ko'chirma → to'g'ri savol: 'does the dog food cost'.

items.textEn: "I've never seen a python," she said to us. → She ___ never seen a python. (told)
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'said to us' → 'told us that she had never seen' (present perfect → past perfect).

items.textEn: "When will we get there?" they asked. → They asked ___ get there. (would)
"I forgot to do my homework," he said. → He said ___ his homework. (forgotten)
items.answer: that he had forgotten to do

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct word in brackets and join the two sentences, as in the example. 1 Many species are endangered. Their natural habitat is disappearing. (but/because) 2 I believe that dogs are the best pets. They can be tiring. (and/although) 3 Green-cheeked parrots are difficult to breed. The species is slowly dying out. (so/also) 4 Rabbits are friendly animals. They can hurt you if they're scared. (and/but) 5 Big dogs need to eat a lot of food. They need a lot of exercise. (so/and) Example: Many species are endangered because their natural habitat is disappearing.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi to'g'ri so'zni tanlang va ikki gapni birlashtiring, namunadagidek. 1 Many species are endangered. Their natural habitat is disappearing. (but/because) 2 I believe that dogs are the best pets. They can be tiring. (and/although) 3 Green-cheeked parrots are difficult to breed. The species is slowly dying out. (so/also) 4 Rabbits are friendly animals. They can hurt you if they're scared. (and/but) 5 Big dogs need to eat a lot of food. They need a lot of exercise. (so/and) Namuna: Ko'p turlar xavf ostida, chunki ularning tabiiy yashash muhiti yo'qolmoqda.
exercises.explanationUz:
BOG'LOVChILAR (coursebook 102-bet
  fikr maqolasi).

  BECAUSE - sabab: endangered
    BECAUSE habitat disappearing
  ALTHOUGH - qarama-qarshilik
    (garchi): best pets ALTHOUGH
    tiring
  SO - natija: difficult to breed
    SO dying out
  BUT - lekin: friendly BUT can
    hurt
  AND - qo'shimcha: a lot of food
    AND a lot of exercise


⚠ 'TO BREED':

  = ko'paytirmoq (hayvon).


⚠ 'TO DIE OUT':

  = yo'qolib ketmoq (tur).


⚠ 'TIRING':

  = charchatadigan.


⚠ 'GREEN-CHEEKED PARROTS':

  = yashil yuzli to'tiqushlar
  (Meksika).
exercises.exampleEn: Many species are endangered because their natural habitat is disappearing.
exercises.exampleUz: Ko'p turlar xavf ostida, chunki ularning tabiiy yashash muhiti yo'qolmoqda.
modelAnswers: I believe that dogs are the best pets, although they can be tiring.
Green-cheeked parrots are difficult to breed, so the species is slowly dying out.
Rabbits are friendly animals, but they can hurt you if they're scared.
Big dogs need to eat a lot of food and they need a lot of exercise.
modelAnswersUz: Itlar eng yaxshi uy hayvonlari deb hisoblayman, garchi ular charchatishi mumkin bo'lsa ham.
Yashil yuzli to'tiqushlarni ko'paytirish qiyin, shuning uchun bu tur sekin yo'qolib bormoqda.
Quyonlar do'stona hayvonlar, lekin qo'rqsalar sizni shikastlashi mumkin.
Katta itlar ko'p ovqat yeyishi va ko'p mashq qilishi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the questions in the list to complete the dialogue below: Would you like to come? / Promise you'll be on time? / What time? / What are you doing this weekend? / What about you?
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi savollar bilan quyidagi dialogni to'ldiring: Would you like to come? / Promise you'll be on time? / What time? / What are you doing this weekend? / What about you?
exercises.explanationUz:
UChRAShUV BELGILASh (coursebook
  102-bet muloqot).

  What are you doing this weekend?
    - rejani so'rash
  What about you? - sizchi?
  Would you like to come? - taklif
  What time? - vaqt
  Promise you'll be on time? -
    va'da so'rash


⚠ 'I HAVEN'T MADE ANY PLANS YET':

  = hali reja tuzmadim.


⚠ 'NOT LATER THAN 11:30':

  = 11:30 dan kech emas.


⚠ 'TO BE ON TIME':

  = o'z vaqtida kelmoq.

patterns.formula: X asked + KIShI + wh-so'z + EGA + FE'L (gap tartibi).

patterns.formula: X told + KIShI + (that) + GAP. / X said (to KIShI) + (that) + GAP.
